list.title: My RFQs
list.description: Every request for quotation you have posted, with the quotations they attracted.
list.emptyDescription: Post a request for quotation and we will match it with verified Vietnamese manufacturers within minutes.

detail.quotationsHint: Compare the offers side by side, then award the order to the supplier you trust.
detail.noQuotationsHint: Matched suppliers have been notified. Most buyers receive their first quotation within 48 hours.
detail.noQuotationsDraft: Publish this RFQ to start receiving quotations.
detail.closeDescription: Suppliers will no longer be able to submit quotations. Quotations you already received stay available.
detail.cancelDescription: The request is withdrawn and any pending quotation expires. This cannot be undone.
detail.visibilityPublic: Public — visible on the RFQ marketplace
detail.publishedBody: {count, plural, =0 {No matching suppliers were found yet — your RFQ is live on the marketplace.} =1 {1 matching supplier has been notified.} other {# matching suppliers have been notified.}}
detail.draftSaved: Draft saved. Publish it when you are ready to receive quotations.

compare.caption: Quotation comparison
compare.yourNotesPlaceholder: Only your team can see this
compare.acceptDescription: We will create a purchase order for {total} and set up the payment schedule from the agreed terms.
compare.tradeAssurance: Protect this order with Trade Assurance
compare.tradeAssuranceHint: Your payment is held by a licensed payment partner and only released to the supplier once you confirm receipt.
compare.orderNotesPlaceholder: Labelling, delivery windows, contact on site…
compare.revisionDescription: {supplier} will be notified and can submit a new revision.
compare.revisionPlaceholder: e.g. Please quote FOB Haiphong and confirm the 45-day lead time for 20,000 units.
compare.rejectDescription: {supplier} will see your reason. Being specific helps them come back with a better offer.
compare.noActions: No actions available for this quotation.

quotations.title: Quotations
quotations.description: Every offer suppliers have sent you, across all your RFQs.
quotations.emptyDescription: Once you publish an RFQ, matched suppliers send their offers here.

form.createDescription: Describe what you need. We match your request with verified manufacturers and notify them instantly.
form.editDescription: Finish the details and publish when you are ready.
form.basicsHint: A clear title and category get your request in front of the right factories.
form.title: RFQ title
form.titleHint: Include the product, quantity and any key spec.
form.titlePlaceholder: e.g. 20,000 hiking backpacks 30–40 L, recycled polyester, private label
form.categoryHint: Used to match suppliers — pick the closest one.
form.visibilityHint: Public RFQs also appear on the CANG RFQ marketplace.
form.descriptionHint: Materials, dimensions, tolerances, colours, compliance, packaging, anything a factory must know to quote accurately.
form.descriptionPlaceholder: Describe the product, the specification, the quality standard and how you will use it…
form.deliveryHint: Where the goods go and how you prefer to trade.
form.incotermHint: Leave empty to let suppliers propose one.
form.certificationsPlaceholder: ISO 9001, BSCI audit report, OEKO-TEX Standard 100 for fabrics
form.customizationPlaceholder: Private label, custom colourways, woven labels, custom hardware…
form.packagingPlaceholder: Polybag + hangtag per unit, 10 units per export carton, carton marking as per our spec
form.sampleRequired: Require a sample before mass production
form.sampleRequiredHint: Most buyers approve a pre-production sample first.
form.lineItemsHint: Optional — break the request into SKUs so suppliers price each one.
form.lineItemsEmpty: No line items. Add them if your request covers several SKUs or sizes.
form.attachmentsHint: Drawings, tech packs, reference photos or a spec sheet.
form.attachmentsFormats: PDF, images, Office documents — up to 10 MB each.
form.inviteSuppliersHint: Optional. We always match verified factories automatically; add names you already know.
form.searchSuppliers: Search suppliers by name or city
form.footerHint: You can save a draft and finish later.
